entity.name: Cámara de Comercio de la Guajira

lineage.description: Commercial establishment locations and attributes were compiled from three sources: official business registry (Cámara de Comercio de la Guajira), online mapping platform (Google Maps), and business directory (Páginas Amarillas). The dataset integrates these sources to create a spatial inventory of WASH-related commercial infrastructure in La Guajira department that supplies COVID-19 prevention materials.
